name: Transaction 167
definition: Specifies the details of the transaction.

AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Owner Transaction Identification
AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account owner (or the instructing party managing the account).

AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.name: Account Servicer Transaction Identification
AccountServicerTransactionIdentification.definition: Unambiguous identification of the transaction as known by the account servicer.

MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.name: Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
MarketInfrastructureTransactionIdentific.definition: Identification of a transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

CounterpartyMarketInfrastructureTransact.name: Counterparty Market Infrastructure Transaction Identification
CounterpartyMarketInfrastructureTransact.definition: Identification of a counterparty transaction assigned by a market infrastructure other than a central securities depository, for example, Target2-Securities.

ProcessorTransactionIdentification.name: Processor Transaction Identification
ProcessorTransactionIdentification.definition: Identification of the transaction assigned by the processor of the instruction other than the account owner, the account servicer and the market infrastructure.

TradeIdentification.name: Trade Identification
TradeIdentification.definition: Reference assigned to the trade by the investor or the trading party. This reference will be used throughout the trade life cycle to access/update the trade details.

UniqueTransactionIdentifier.name: Unique Transaction Identifier
UniqueTransactionIdentifier.definition: Unique Transaction Identifier (UTI) as agreed with the other counterparty.

PoolIdentification.name: Pool Identification
PoolIdentification.definition: Collective reference identifying a set of messages.

CommonIdentification.name: Common Identification
CommonIdentification.definition: Unique reference agreed upon by the two trade counterparties to identify the trade.

CorporateActionEventIdentification.name: Corporate Action Event Identification
CorporateActionEventIdentification.definition: Identification assigned by the account servicer to unambiguously identify a corporate action event.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Collateral Transaction Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralTr.definition: Unique identification identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the triparty-agent's/service-provider's point of view.

ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.name: Client Triparty Collateral Transaction Identification
ClientTripartyCollateralTransactionIdent.definition: Unique reference identifying the triparty collateral management transaction from the client's point of view.

ClientCollateralInstructionIdentificatio.name: Client Collateral Instruction Identification
ClientCollateralInstructionIdentificatio.definition: Unique identification assigned to the instruction by the client.

TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralIn.name: Triparty Agent Service Provider Collateral Instruction Identification
TripartyAgentServiceProviderCollateralIn.definition: Unique identification assigned to the instruction by the triparty-agent/service-provider.

MasterReference.name: Master Reference
MasterReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous identifier for a group of individual orders, as assigned by the instructing party. This identifier links the individual orders together.

ClientReference.name: Client Reference
ClientReference.definition: Unique and unambiguous investor's identification of an order. This reference can typically be used in a hub scenario to give the reference of the order as assigned by the underlying client.

AccountOwnerLegIdentification.name: Account Owner Leg Identification
AccountOwnerLegIdentification.definition: Unique technical identifier for the instance of the leg within a switch.

AccountServicerLegIdentification.name: Account Servicer Leg Identification
AccountServicerLegIdentification.definition: Unique identifier for the instance of the leg execution within a switch confirmation.

TransactionDetails.name: Transaction Details
TransactionDetails.definition: Identifies the details of the transaction.

SupplementaryData.name: Supplementary Data
SupplementaryData.definition: Additional information that cannot be captured in the structured elements and/or any other specific block.

NoAccountOwnerTransactionIdentificationR.definition: If no reference is available for the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification, for example, the transaction was sent by fax, then the AccountOwnerTransactionIdentification must be NONREF.
